title: Linear logo row
description: A row of white customer wordmarks spread edge to edge across the page frame, with a small grey monospace caption in capitals under it. On phones the row becomes a slow, endless marquee sliding left.
notes: seven logos fit the desktop row; phones loop the same list (it is drawn twice for a seamless loop)
CSS only; with reduced motion the phone row stays still and can be swiped
